reviews.review:
This is no Quickerflak, but it's close. This game is heavily inspired by the work of Walther Manchado; a man known for making "standalone minigames" of high quality.

3 Seconds Remaining is an arcade top-down shooter minigame. The gunplay is smooth and responsive, the visuals are clean, and I like the difficulty curve that stems from starting with a shotgun, but being made to switch to a pistol to conserve ammo.

While I like the game, it is currently lacking in polish: The player has no death state, resulting in the game over screen being bugged; the camera feels a bit too zoomed-in, making it hard to read the room; and the default sound volume is quite loud. All of these things are easily fixed, likely just a solid day of polishing would clean up these issues. There's also a translation issue: the game is listed as being translated into 103 languages, but is only available in English. Tiny.ROM, if you are reading this, please look up "PolyglotGamedev", it will make translating your game so much easier. Though, it doesn't support all 103 of the languages you've listed.

Overall, this is a solid minigame at a decent price, my only gripes are fairly easy to fix, and I hope the developer goes on to make more games.
